verdict.rationale: GlitchTip's error-tracking docs tell JavaScript users to use the GlitchTip CLI to inject debug IDs and upload source maps for readable stack traces, and a dedicated CLI page documents release and deploy commands usable from CI. The CLI is labeled Beta, and the source-map upload command syntax is not shown. Missing for 10: documented source-map upload command and CI workflow example, explicit bundler-plugin support (only a general Sentry-compatibility claim), non-Beta CLI maturity, independent or hands-on corroboration that symbolication works.
